# Find friends without sharing a journal

Two independent Google accounts choose discoverable names and connect only after the recipient accepts. Journal text stays private; blocking revokes the connection on both devices, and unblocking does not restore it. Every action has an unmasked zero-pixel screenshot with checks below the image.

Viewport: mobile-chromium.
